title: VTN Registry — Check — payload
description: Ask the network to ask its trust registry about one party. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

member.description: The action acknowledged members are published under.

listed.description: The action listed parties are published under, where the network publishes them.

Response.title: VTN Registry — Check — response payload
Response.description: What the registry answered, and its own answer document.

authority.description: The network's DID: the authority of its records.

resource.description: The TRQP resource the network's records are published under.

reachable.description: Whether the registry answered. `false` is indeterminate, never "not a member".

member.description: Whether the registry holds an authorised member record for the party. Absent when not reachable.

listed.description: Whether the registry holds an authorised listed record for the party. Absent when not reachable.

answer.description: The registry's answer document, verbatim and signed by the registry.

reason.description: Why the registry could not be asked, when not reachable.
